{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Greenfield |characters=グリーンフィールド |japanese=Greenfield |image=Greenfield Normal.png |imagesize=270px |caption=Greenfield |region=Johto |epicode=M03 |episode=Spell of the Unown: Entei }} [[File:Greenfield Unown Spell.png|thumb|250px|Greenfield while under the Unown spell]] '''Greenfield''' (Japanese: '''グリーンフィールド''' ''Greenfield'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive town in [[Johto]]. This is the setting for ''[[M03|Spell of the Unown: Entei]]''. According to a map in {{aniseries|PTS}}, Greenfield is located just southeast of [[Goldenrod City]], between Goldenrod City and [[Cherrygrove City]]. ==Geography== Greenfield's sweeping green valleys filled with fields of flowers and windmills make it an incredibly scenic location. According to {{an|Misty}}, Greenfield is one of the most beautiful locations in [[Johto]]. It contains a [[Pokémon Center]] and a play park, where {{OBP|Lisa|M03}} and {{Ash}} battled. The Hale mansion is a significant landmark, being the home of {{p|Unown}} researcher [[Spencer Hale]], his wife, and their daughter [[Molly Hale|Molly]]. ==History== In Greenfield, Molly discovered some tiles that her father left behind when he was kidnapped by the Unown and sent into the [[Unown Dimension]]. The tiles contained the {{OBP|Unown|M03}}, and over the course of the {{pkmn|movie}}, the pristine environment was almost completely crystallized thanks to the Unown's efforts to fulfill Molly's fantasies. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} intervened, they managed to get Molly to abandon her fantasy world in order to restore the real one. With her newfound belief, an illusory {{OBP|Entei|M03}} created by the Unown broke through the swarming Unown's barrier, which then restored Greenfield to its former beauty. ==Gallery== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{johto color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{johto color dark}}" |- style="background:#{{johto color light}}" ! style="{{roundytl|5px}}" | {{color2|000|Pokémon Center}} ! style="{{roundytl|5px}}" | Hale Mansion |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Greenfield Pokémon Center.png|x150px]] | [[File:Greenfield Hale Mansion.png|x150px]] |} ==In other languages== {{langtable|color={{colorschemelight|GS}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|GS}} |da=Greenfield |nl=Greenfield |fi=Greenfield |fr=Greenfield |de=Greenfield |is=Grænunvöllur
